stories.title: Anthony Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment at tense Senate hearing
stories.summary: Republicans threatened repercussions after Anthony Fauci repeatedly invoked the Fifth Amendment rather than answer questions during a contentious Senate hearing on Covid-19.

stories.title: Footage shows immigration agents using slurs to describe Latinos targeted in raids
stories.summary: Bodycam footage and texts show immigration agents using slurs about Latinos targeted in Los Angeles raids. The ACLU uncovered the evidence in its lawsuit alleging racial profiling.

stories.title: Oregon is on track for its worst wildfire season yet
stories.summary: Wildfires in central and eastern Oregon are prompting evacuations and forcing ranchers to scramble to move cattle and find feed as public range land burns. More than a million acres have burned so far. Most fires have little or no containment.

stories.title: The Federal Reserve is setting U.S. interest rates. What will that look like?
stories.summary: The Federal Reserve met to set U.S. interest rates, but this time, investors are unsure what to expect with Kevin Warsh, the new Federal Reserve Chairman, at the helm.

stories.title: Maryland Baby Boomers introduce the joy of snail mail to an emoji generation
stories.summary: Volunteers at a Maryland senior living community bring back letter writing in a unique pen pal program.

stories.title: The race is on for the next United Nations secretary general
stories.summary: The United Nations Security Council will begin straw polls Thursday to whittle down the field of candidates for the next U.N. secretary-general. Seven candidates are running to replace António Guterres.
